Name: Door Mania (PIF) and more wall decor
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This started out as a simple door pack but got a little bit out of hand, resulting in [b]over 200 different doors[/b], as well as a lot of other wall furniture like [b]windows, lamps, shelves and garlands [/b]to customize your walls to your hearts content.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1774348809.png[/img]

The furniture can be found in the door catalogue and the wall decor catalogue, both of which can be purchased at Robin's or the PIF magician's.

Need more wall space? Check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29886]PIF Corridors[/url].

There are two optional AT versions, one for replacing vanilla doors and doors added by PIF, the other replacing the doors from this mod (separated by type of door due to load time). The day/night change that some doors have won't apply for the AT version due to limitations of AT.

[b]A lot of this furniture is meant to be layered. For this to work correctly, you will need to install either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27226?tab=posts&BH=0]Wall Decorations[/url]﻿ or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21233]Anything Anywhere [/url]together with this mod so that you can use the furniture like it is meant to. [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] adds another layer of decorating freedom so I recommend that as well.[/b][/b]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528136.png[/img]

[b]Door catalogue
[/b]1-tile wide doors:
[list]
[*]Decorative doors based on vanilla design - total of 80 different designs/colours
[*]Sunroom doors - total of 30 different designs/colours, day/night change, window effect when MMAP installed
[*]Colourful doors - total of 64 different designs/colours (some with windows that have day/night change and window effect when MMAP installed)
[*]Plank doors - total of 18 different designs/colours
[*]Separate frames for all 1-tile wide doors, two different shapes, 5 colour options
[/list]2-tile wide doors[list]
[*]Exterior doors with individual design - total of 32 designs, some with day/night change and window effect when MMAP installed
[/list]3-tile wide doors[list]
[*]Hobbit doors - 6 different designs/colours
[/list]Stairs
[list]
[*]3 staircases of different widths
[*]2 different borders to place around like in farmhouse
[/list]
[b]Wall decor catalogue[/b][list]
[*]Windows 2 tile height - 17 different styles, some meant to put together to make a wider window
[*]Windows 1 tile height - 5 different styles (decreasing in size)
[*]Windows 3 tile height - 4 different styles, meant to put together to make a wider window
[*]Lamps - 7 different styles
[*]Light strings - 4 1-tile width, 5 2-tile width, 2 3-tile width
[*]Garlands - 15 styles
[*]Shelves - 15 styles, one of them empty, the others with various clutter
[*]Wall plant - 2 styles
[*]Curtains - 6 different colours, left and right version
[*]Curtain fringes to go with curtains
[*]Wainscoting, 5 colours, 2 styles
[*]Wall borders, 5 colours
[/list]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528224.png[/img]
[/b]
The doors are all based on various doors found in vanilla which have been made to fit the farmhouse interior. This goes for the other items as well, they are based on vanilla colours. The CP version includes a toned down version that should work with recolours.
You don't need PIF for this to function (the PIF part will simply don't load which will show up in your SMAPI log).


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528397.png[/img]

Requires Content Patcher. Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. 1.6 and SMAPI required.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528525.png[/img]
